s.note: Flaky pastry rolls of pork, fennel and sage sausage meat, brushed with egg and sesame, with tomato relish
s.how: Heat the oven to 210C and line two trays. Mix 500g pork sausage mince with the grated onion, crushed fennel, sage, breadcrumbs and pepper. Halve each pastry sheet, lay a line of filling along one long edge, roll up and seal with beaten egg. Cut into 4cm lengths, brush with egg, sprinkle with sesame seeds and snip a small slash in each top. Bake until puffed, golden and cooked through. Serve warm with the tomato relish.

s.note: Soft pizza dough knotted into bone shapes, brushed with garlic and parsley butter and parmesan
s.how: Heat the oven to 220C and line two trays. On a lightly floured bench, divide the dough into 12, roll each into a 20cm rope and tie a loose knot at each end so it looks like a bone. Lay on the trays and leave to rise a little. Mix the butter, garlic and parsley and brush half over the bones. Bake until golden. Brush with the rest of the garlic butter and sprinkle with the salt and parmesan.

m.note: Whole chicken roasted with honey, thyme and garlic over carrots, parsnips and onions, with pan gravy
m.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Pat the chicken dry, rub with the butter, thyme, salt and pepper and push the lemon halves inside. Toss the carrots, parsnips, onions and garlic with the oil in a roasting tin and sit the chicken on top. Roast for 1 hour. Brush the chicken with the honey and roast until the juices run clear. Rest the chicken on a board and keep the vegetables warm. Stir the flour into the pan juices, whisk in 300ml chicken stock and simmer to a gravy. Carve and serve with the vegetables and gravy.

w.note: Spiced honey and ginger loaf cake with toasted almonds, a honey drizzle and thick cream
w.how: Heat the oven to 170C and grease and line a loaf tin. Melt 250g honey with the butter and brown sugar and cool a little. Whisk in the eggs and milk, then fold in the flour, ginger, cinnamon and cloves. Pour into the tin and scatter with the almonds. Bake until a skewer comes out clean. Cool in the tin. Drizzle with the extra honey and serve in thick slices with the cream.

d.n: Henry the Red's spiced mead punch
d.note: Mead warmed with cloudy apple juice, orange, ginger, cinnamon and cloves, served in heavy mugs
d.how: Put everything in a pot and warm gently without letting it boil. Take off the heat and leave to steep. Ladle into 4 heavy mugs with a slice of orange in each.
